jobs.requeue_command: Repeat the identical generated batch payload; pool resumes automatically without a --resume flag.

requeue_review.behavior: Identical pool invocation automatically validates manifest and preserves committed raw JSONL cases; torn final tail is archived before truncation.
same_hardware_required: same visible-device mapping; payload unsets CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES so pool sorts physical indices
same_science_required: same project code commit and every authored Python file
same plan, asset/source receipts and registries
requeue_review.normal_preemption: Cluster preempt/partition_prio with REQUEUE; low-priority tier1 may be preempted by higher tier partitions; no grace period is configured.
requeue_review.restart_semantics: --requeue permits Slurm preemption requeue; it does not make arbitrary failures or the12h wall limit automatically restart.
requeue_review.end_time_signal: B:USR1@120 requests a batch-controller warning before the wall limit; it does not guarantee120s preemption notice. Pool handles USR1/TERM and terminates only its worker groups.
requeue_review.blocker_if_deployment_changes: Any changed live source/commit/config/preparation identity after the first attempt causes resume to fail closed, preserving evidence. Freeze final project deployment through all reference jobs.
requeue_review.incomplete_case_behavior: Completed measured records are retained. In-flight unfinished generations rerun with the same seeded case plan; model load/warmup repeats and is excluded from measured timing.

hardware_scope: Actual GPU memory and driver are queried only after the job owns the full allocation; this preparation makes no new hardware measurement.
mutations_performed: Local JSON preparation only; no Slurm submission or GPU operation.

submission_environment_policy.mode: Copy the normal inherited submission environment and remove credentials, Python injection variables and inherited Slurm option controls before subprocess.run(..., env=sanitized).

environment_export_review.installed_man: Variable-list exports are documented; the installed man does not disclose that the implementation forces login-environment retrieval.
environment_export_review.implementation: ALL merges the supplied process environment without changing get_user_env_time; NONE and every other variable-list path set get_user_env_time=0 and cause SLURM_GET_USER_ENV=1 to be injected.
environment_export_review.decision: Use --export=ALL with a sanitized submission subprocess environment; never set --get-user-env or pass inherited controls that request it. Do not modify HOME.
